items.html: And the matter is — know that the Name of Havayah has four fillings, which are: AV (72), SaG (63), MA (45), and BaN (52). And each one is an aspect of 72. For also the Name SaG, with the ten letters of the filling, is 73. And likewise the Name MA, with the count of its four simple letters, which are twenty-six, together with MA — behold, 71; and with the extra Aleph that is in the Name SaG, which made it 73, there are 72. And the Name BaN, in its aspect of its posteriors, which is: Yud, Yud-Hei, Yud-Hei-Vav, Yud-Hei-Vav-Hei, is 72. Behold, they are three times 72, in their joining with other counts, as mentioned.
